title: Create and Configure an Index for Summary Data
objectives: Create and Configure an Index for Summary Data
Verify result values and the persisted operational evidence.

tasks.instruction: The fixture has three explicit source_logs events and starts with the clock paused. Keep it paused while configuring, then use clock controls or the Interview Workbench advance action for scheduled work.
Create source_stats as an Events index on standalone idx01, with retention=2592000 seconds. Inspect the effective definition and verify it is empty.
Explain which operation will populate it later. A name containing summary does not itself enable summary indexing.

hints: Inspect the source results and time window before saving or scheduling a report.
Use savedsearches.conf or simulated REST to independently verify the definition; inspect actual execution history and search the summary destination.
